# Pull Request Template

## Description
Brief description of the changes in this PR.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change (consensus, wire format, RPC API)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / cleanup
- [ ] CI / infrastructure

## Related RFC / KVP
- [ ] RFC-001 Multisig
- [ ] RFC-002 Native Tokens
- [ ] RFC-003 Stealth + Script v2
- [ ] RFC-004 HTLC / Atomic Swap
- [ ] RFC-005 Vault / CSV
- [ ] RFC-006 Tokenomics
- [ ] Not RFC-related

## Testing
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (all workspaces)
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests for new functionality
- [ ] Tested locally on testnet (if applicable)

## Consensus Impact
- [ ] No consensus changes
- [ ] Consensus change — activation score / fork required
- [ ] Wire format change — testnet reset required
- [ ] Genesis change — testnet reset required

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published

## Additional Notes
Any additional context, screenshots, or links to related issues.
